up: Retrieve approved drugs indicated for pancreatic carcinoma. Join molecule_dictionary and drug_indication on molregno. Filter for molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4. Filter for drug_indication.efo_term or drug_indication.mesh_heading containing 'pancreatic carcinoma' or 'pancreatic neoplasms' using case-insensitive matching. Return the drug preferred name (pref_name) and the indication term (efo_term). Do not apply any row limits.
sql:
SELECT
  md.pref_name,
  di.efo_term
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno
WHERE
  md.max_phase = 4
  AND (
    LOWER(di.efo_term) LIKE '%pancreatic carcinoma%'
    OR LOWER(di.efo_term) LIKE '%pancreatic neoplasms%'
    OR LOWER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%pancreatic carcinoma%'
    OR LOWER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%pancreatic neoplasms%'
  )
